title: Chip stocks: the Nvidia earnings reaction is worse than you think, 46 counted
description:
Free options app: https://www.signumhq.com/app?src=yt_us2

Nvidia reports Wednesday, August 26. Consensus is $2.09 EPS on $92.1B revenue.

Everyone says the market waits on this. We counted 46 reports back to 2015 and measured what the S&P 500 did the next day.

The index moved 1.172% intraday on those days against 1.125% otherwise. That is 1.04x, t = 0.38 — nowhere near the 1.96 you would need. Statistically an Nvidia earnings day is indistinguishable from an ordinary session.

Nvidia itself is also moving less. The first five reports averaged 9.88% the next day. The last five averaged 2.88%. Across all 46 the trend is rho -0.305, t -2.12.

One thing does move: the other chips. AMD matched Nvidia's direction 67.4% of the time, Broadcom 63.0%, Micron 60.9% — 88 of 138, sign test p = 0.0015.

We counted size, not cause, and we say nothing about direction.

Prices are split-adjusted closes. Earnings dates from the reported calendar.

evidence: FMP stable earnings calendar for NVDA (59 reports, 46 with usable next-day prices, 2015 to 2026-05) x FMP stable adjusted closes

story.mechanism: The claim that the whole market waits on this report is repeated every quarter and never counted. Measured across 46 reports, the index barely reacts, and Nvidia's own reaction has been shrinking as it grew.

insight.claim: Across 46 Nvidia reports the S&P 500's next-day range was 1.04x a normal day, t = 0.38 — statistically indistinguishable
insight.saidAs: We cannot tell the two apart.
